box_obb_m.note: HELIUM-3 cargo box, OBB fitted per frame to the skinned box vertices

result.min_where: box starting down the lowerator (lower segment, t 19.7 s in box_path) beside the west end of the truss (bottom chord / end portal, y ~7.25) at Refinery ~(9.99, 7.25, 16.09)
result.yaw_note: yaw 90 constant from the infeed to table_turn; table_turn 32.8-33.8 s smoothstep 90->0; no other rotation, no snaps

Shoes run 2.2 cm off the rack strip and 2.0 cm off the panel bands. Cable + shoes are in the Lift_Carriage set (cable top end + sheave skinned to Bridge_Base) and are also tested against every box.

peak_speed_mps.lowerator_plateau: 19.31-24.99 s, box base y 7.6 -> 1.9 (eased 1 s at each end)

carriage_cycle.note: One carriage serves every box. Box_N+1 may start its timeline no sooner than min_box_start_gap_s after Box_N (box_convey uses phase_s). wait_for_box = from the box coming within 0.05 m (plan) of the carriage deck at the top until it is centred and the descent starts. If boxes come faster, hold the next box on the span rollers with its centre >= queue_back_from_lift_centre_m back from the lift centre (at or before queue_point_refinery_xyz, box on the end of the span conveyor, base y 8.1) until carriage_free_at_s of the previous box, then resume its timeline; never let a box onto the lowerator while the carriage is below the top.

box_convey_loop.loop_clean: first and last keys identical for every channel

box_path.method: Every frame at 30 Hz: each visible box OBB (fitted every frame to its skinned vertices in its bone frame) vs every triangle within 0.5 m of it (static bridge mesh, rollers, lift carriage, other boxes), exact triangle-OBB distance (SAT overlap depth when they intersect). Clearance = distance from the OBB to the part of each triangle above the box base plane + 3 cm (triangles clipped at that plane); below it is the support the box rides on (rollers, carriage deck, turntable). Clearances are capped at 0.5 m (search radius). Carriage vs static: exact triangle-triangle distance every frame.

support.note: highest support geometry inside the box footprint, above the box base plane (<= 0.03 by the split; anything higher counts as a hit in min_clearance)

box_over_shaft_without_carriage.note: frames where a box overlaps the carriage deck in plan by > 5 cm but its base is > 2 cm above the deck top (box over the open shaft), below the span deck level
